### 🟡 Changes recommended The new `tests/systemd-exec-smoke.sh` has assertions that don’t match the actual `systemd-run` argv (`--property=...`), which will cause the CI regression test to fail. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR addresses systemd `203/EXEC` / `Permission denied` restart loops on Debian 13 upgrades by normalizing sing-box executable permissions/capabilities per init backend and adding a systemd sandbox preflight + stronger diagnostics during install/doctor/repair flows. **Changes:** - Add backend-specific capability handling: systemd clears stale file capabilities; OpenRC retains minimal `cap_net_bind_service`. - Add `systemd-run` transient preflight using key hardening/capability properties aligned with the permanent unit, plus improved runtime execution diagnostics. - Add CI coverage and a new regression test for systemd exec/capability behavior; bump version/docs/changelog.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | VERSION | Bump version to `0.1.0-alpha.4`. | | lib/common.sh | Update default `SBM_VERSION` to `0.1.0-alpha.4`. | | lib/runtime-security.sh | New capability normalization helpers, systemd sandbox preflight, and execution diagnostics. | | lib/core.sh | Ensure capability normalization runs during core download/switch/rollback paths. | | setup.sh | Stop restart loops before service replacement, add systemd start-rate limiting, preflight before start, and richer diagnostics on failures. | | lib/doctor.sh | Extend doctor/repair to detect/repair stale capabilities and systemd sandbox execution failures with diagnostics. | | tests/systemd-exec-smoke.sh | New regression test for systemd capability cleanup + transient preflight arguments. | | .github/workflows/ci.yml | Run the new systemd exec regression test (Ubuntu + Debian 13 job). | | README.md | Document the 203/EXEC scenario and remediation; mention the new test. | | CHANGELOG.md | Add `0.1.0-alpha.4` release notes summarizing the fix and coverage. |
